signals.ai_share_evidence: Markers: polished single-drop repo (3 commits in ~24h) with an exhaustively structured README could suggest heavy AI drafting; counter-evidence: results table reports the author's own hybrid LOSING to baseline (Hit@10 0.202 vs 0.281), explicit limitations (4x inference cost, careful RQ-VAE tuning), external HF models/dataset and video demo, and AI use disclosed narrowly ('Cleaned with Gemini 2.5 Flash for quality').

counter_evidence.excerpt: The one-shot commit pattern ('Init', 'Fix wrong reference to repo', 'Clean up demo') is consistent with GPU-instance development then publication: setup.sh (7000 B) is a GPU setup script and README says training needs 48GB+ VRAM.

README publishes an unflattering result (semantic-ID SASRec underperforms baseline SASRec on all three metrics: Hit@10 0.202 vs 0.281) plus a Limitations section - the opposite of fabricated-success slop.

Deliverables extend beyond the repo: named HF artifacts (eugeneyan/semantic-id-qwen3-8b-video-games, video-games-semantic-ids-mapping), a writeup URL, and a YouTube demo are all linked; 10 numbered pipeline notebooks (01-10) and 6 src training scripts match the described 4-stage pipeline.
root-listing.json: uv.lock (482464 B) and demo.ipynb (40825 B) corroborate a real, resolved dependency tree and a substantive runnable demo.

counter_evidence_review.outcome: one-shot publication pattern is explained by off-repo GPU development; honest negative results and disclosed limitations outweigh the dump signal; not classified negative

evidence_conflicts.description: README Installation offers 'pip install -r requirements.txt' but root-listing.json contains no requirements.txt (only pyproject.toml + uv.lock); the primary uv path is valid

notes: Substantial research artifact: RQ-VAE semantic IDs plus two-stage Qwen3-8B finetuning, with a 10-notebook pipeline and 6 training scripts that match the README's described stages. Published as a near one-shot drop (3 commits), which is explained by off-repo GPU training and offset by honest negative results, a real limitations section, and externally hosted models. AI usage (Gemini for data cleaning) is explicitly disclosed.
